chunks: And in the narration of Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from one whom he mentioned, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام.
That he said concerning the interpretation of this verse:
If you see them loving the family of Muhammad عليهم السلام, then raise them one degree.

key_terms.آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ: the family of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.تَفْسِيرِ: interpretation or explanation of a verse
key_terms.دَرَجَةً: a rank or degree of standing

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith interpret the verse in relation to love for the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام?
ai.summary: This narration presents an interpretive rendering that ties recognition of worth to love for آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ عليهم السلام. It frames محبت of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام as a sign by which a person's rank is elevated.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5524 - In the narration of Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from someone who mentioned from Abu Abdullah (as), that Imam (as) said in the interpretation of this verse:

"If you perceive in them sound judgment, then deliver their wealth to them"
(Surah An-Nisa 4:6).
Imam (as) said: "If you see that they love the family of Muhammad (sw), peace be upon them, then elevate them in status."
